items.title: 20.1.2 Atomic Orbital Structure of Benzene (benzene ka atomic orbital structure) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.1.2 with Quick Check 20.1 answered, printed pages 58-59.

blocks.text: Benzene ring ka hexagonal framework (dhancha) hybridization approach (tareeqe) se aasani se samjha ja sakta hai. Is ke mutabiq benzene ka har carbon atom sp² hybridized hai. Har carbon ke teen sp² hybrid orbitals teen σ-bonds banate hain: do saath wale carbon atoms ke saath aur ek hydrogen atom ke saath. Tamam sp² orbitals ek hi plane (chapti satah) mein hain, is liye is σ framework ke sab carbon aur hydrogen atoms ek hi plane mein, 120° par, hain.

Har carbon ka ek '2p' orbital hybrid nahi hota; aise chhe 2p orbitals hain. Yeh σ framework ke perpendicular (90° par seedhe khare) aur aapas mein parallel hain. Yeh sideways (pehlu se pehlu) overlap kar ke benzene ring ki plane ke oopar aur neeche π-electron cloud (badal) banate hain; is liye molecule conjugated (milay hue π bonds wala) hai. Is overlap se chhe electrons chhe ke chhe carbons mein barabar bat jate hain. Ise π electrons ki delocalization kehte hain.

Is delocalization ki wajah se chhe ke chhe C - C bonds ki length barabar (139 pm) hai, jo C–C (154 pm) aur C=C (133 pm) ke darmiyan hai. Isi liye benzene ko hexagon ke andar circle bana kar dikhate hain; circle delocalised π electrons ko dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse. (a) Sigma framework (dhancha): hexagon mein chhe carbons; har C-C bond do milte sp2 lobes se aur har C-H bond sp2 lobe aur H orbital ke milne se; labels sp2-sp2 C-C sigma bond aur sp2-s C-H sigma bond. (b) Ring perspective (tirchi nazar) se, har carbon ke oopar neeche p orbital ke do lobes aur un ke sideways overlap (pehlu se pehlu milna) ki dashed lines. (c) Delocalised pi cloud C6H6 framework ke oopar aur neeche do rings (chhallon) ki shakal mein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) Har carbon ke teen sp² orbitals ek plane mein 120° par hain: do saath wale carbons se C–C σ bond aur teesra H se C–H σ bond banata hai. (b) Har carbon ka bacha hua p orbital plane ke perpendicular hai aur saath wale p orbitals se pehlu se pehlu milta hai. (c) Yeh mil kar ring ke oopar aur neeche ek delocalised π cloud bana dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab ki figure (a) mein C–H bond ko 'sp²–sp² C–H σ bond' likha hai.
Sahi: hydrogen ka orbital 1s hai (hybrid nahi), is liye C–H bond sp²–s σ bond hai, jaisa upar ki drawing mein hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Benzene ki delocalization (resonance) energy taqreeban 152 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. Is ka kya matlab hai, aur yeh benzene ki reactivity (react karne ki tezi) par kya asar dalti hai?
blocks.explanation: Benzene alag alag teen double bonds wale ring se 152 kJ mol⁻¹ zyada stable hai. Jo reaction delocalised π system tor de (jaise addition), us mein yeh energy khoni parti hai, is liye benzene alkenes se kam reactive hai aur substitution karta hai, jis mein ring bachi rehti hai.

blocks.prompt: b) X-ray batata hai ke benzene planar hai. Agar planar na hota to reactivity mein kya farq hota?
blocks.explanation: Phir p orbitals sab aapas mein overlap na kar pate aur π electrons delocalised na hote. Benzene alag double bonds wale alkene ki tarah rehta aur aasani se addition reactions karta.

blocks.prompt: c) Benzene ring ke sab bonds ki lambai barabar kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Chhe π electrons chhe carbons par barabar phaile hain, is liye har C–C bond ek jaisa hai, single aur double bond ke darmiyan (139 pm).

blocks.prompt: d) Atomic orbital concept benzene mein π electrons ki delocalization kaise samjhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Har sp² carbon ke paas ring ki plane ke perpendicular ek p orbital hai. Chhe parallel p orbitals poore ring mein pehlu se pehlu overlap karte hain, is liye un ke electrons teen alag π bonds ke bajaye ring ke oopar aur neeche ek continuous (lagatar, bina toote) cloud banate hain.

items: Har carbon sp²: ek plane mein 120° par teen σ bonds.
Chhe p orbitals pehlu se pehlu overlap: ring ke oopar neeche delocalised π cloud.
Sab C–C bonds 139 pm; nishani: hexagon ke andar circle.
